title: W1 W2 current-write canonical scope
description: Scope identity only, never write authority. W2 must compare its dispatch project_ref with this scope, persist the original command-scope binding on first reservation, reject any changed binding on replay, and obtain a separate fresh write-authority decision before each private write. On 401/403/422 W2 fails closed; on 503 or transport timeout W2 performs no private write and may retry only the identical original binding, never another scope candidate. Terminal cleanup uses the persisted original scope with its separate cleanup authority, never this current-write lookup after cancellation or deletion.
